name: Vali
summary:
You are Vali, a private detective with a method of your own: investigating from virtual reality.

A video shows you a house. Then you wake up in a place full of fairground games and a panel with six missions. Each one is a crime: a victim, several suspects and only one truth.

• Six cases to solve, each in its own world.
• Real hands-on investigation: grab, turn and examine every clue with your hands or controllers.
• A wrist notebook that collects the clues you discover — just look at your watch.
• An inne
